experiment.title: Attempt-bound path-only SGCP matched-density family protocol v18
experiment.objective: Independently verify an exact 168-row, 672-cap-cell family matrix measuring whether any of three coordinate predicates, composed with one frozen degree-two representative compiler, retains more structured-embedding final support than four matched hash-ranked controls at the same constrained-label budget on generated 5-8 bit prime-order curves.

canonical_grid.row_order: bits, then seed, then B, then the three coordinate families, then null replicates 0 through 3

curve_generation.model: short Weierstrass y^2=x^3+ax+b over F_p with p>3
curve_generation.draw: domain-separated SHA-256 derivation of p-index, a, and b from bits, seed, and draw number
curve_generation.accept: prime q=#E(F_p) with exact requested bit length
curve_generation.provenance: record every draw and all applicable rejection reasons, including duplicate plus mathematical reasons; order duplicate first, then singular or wrong-bit, nonprime-order, trace-zero, anomalous, j-zero, and j-1728 reasons; verifier independently rederives the complete transcript
curve_generation.cross_seed_rule: the eight accepted (p,a,b,q) records must be distinct
curve_generation.generator: least affine point in canonical (x,y) order; every nonidentity point generates because q is prime

factor_base.fiber_rule: select exactly B/2 distinct two-point x-fibers and include both signs
factor_base.mobius_derivation: domain-separated SHA-256 with first nonzero-determinant nonce; verifier rederives every parameter and nonce
factor_base.emitted_binding: family, replicate, B, admissible roots, selected roots, poles, public parameters, root polynomial, points, and selection digest

representative_compiler.rule: for every nonidentity EC output of a degree-two factor-base multiset, retain the lexicographically least formal witness
representative_compiler.scope: part of the tested construction; results are not factor-base invariant
representative_compiler.receipt: emit the complete public representative table and its SHA-256 digest

ordering_contract.factor_points: ascending reduced affine (x,y), zero-based indices, nondecreasing formal tuples
ordering_contract.mixed_formals: shorter degree first, then integer-tuple lexicographic order
ordering_contract.points_and_labels: identity first; affine points ascending (x,y); labels exactly O or unsigned decimal x:y
ordering_contract.predicate_ties: least-x by x; Mobius by (score,x) with poles excluded; two-map alternation map 0 then 1; hash-null by (lowercase SHA-256 hex,x)
ordering_contract.representatives: lexicographically least nondecreasing formal tuple for each nonidentity EC output

inputs.serialization_contract: closed key sets and exact JSON value types throughout V18 rows, documents, summary, family gate, nested integrity receipts, verification reports, publication receipts, and publication results; booleans, integers, and floats are never interchangeable even when Python equality would equate them
inputs.verifier_input_contract: path-based verify_document is the sole evidence-bearing API; every public call creates one invocation-local verifier state, binds it to the creating thread, marks it closed before restoring the prior context, and rejects direct re-entry into the active path worker; semantic row/document helpers require the active process-local path permit and the worker body requires its invocation-local token before mathematical work; copied contexts fail from another thread and after public-call closure; public direct legacy-row and density-row APIs remain disabled; the producer's public generated_curve and build_legacy_row entry points raise, and build_density_row admits only the exact frozen p=19 B4 control before factor-base work; accept only the V18 document schema and reject V1-V17 without row verification; open the final path component with no-follow and nonblocking flags, require a regular file, and reject an initial st_size above 256 MiB before allocation or reading; read directly into one exact-size bytearray, hash that same snapshot, require stable file identity and exact length, then apply an ASCII lexical preflight with no insignificant whitespace, at most 2000000 scalar/container/string tokens, depth 64, 8 MiB raw string tokens, and 1024-byte scalar tokens before object construction; strictly ASCII-decode the same bytearray, clear it before standard JSON parsing, and retain duplicate-key and nonfinite-number rejection; parent path components may traverse symlinks; reflect at most 4096 ASCII path bytes or a bounded omission marker; after parsing, apply source-sized document, row, parameter, family-gate, map, reason, formal, edge, source-table, frontier, and byte-receipt bounds before the generic JSON walk; then limit the object graph to 2000000 nodes, depth 64, and 8 MiB strings/keys; admit only exact registered frozen or canonical row/grid/cap associations; limit independent primary nodes to exact integers in 0..5000000
inputs.verifier_work_contract: keep actual work, resource reservation, and registered-curve cache data inside the invocation-local state; reject every raw work mutation unless its amount is an exact positive integer; before row semantics, authenticate nested digests and byte accounting, reconstruct summary and family gate, then reserve separate source-bounded totals for registered prime candidates, curve draws and hashes, predicate hashes, frozen, semantic, and primary point enumerations, expansion cells, graph candidate evaluations, eligible conflict checks, eligible pair-output cells, replay nodes, independent primary nodes, both replay caches, both primary caches, retained-model calls, and retained-model cells; reject any over-limit reservation; increment graph and expansion counters inside each executed loop and globally charge replay/proof nodes and cache entries at execution or insertion; preserve partial failing-function lower bounds and the reservation on exceptions, including predicate reconstruction; on every completed row require exact counter deltas for reconstructed candidates, eligible-pair conflicts, eligible-squared pair outputs, and degree 1, 2, 4, and 8 expansion multisets; only after every row passes semantic curve and factor-base reconstruction, derive and equality-check exact completed registered prime-candidate, curve-draw, curve-hash, curve-point-enumeration, and predicate-hash counts from the verified public transcripts; require complete actual work, source-owned actual-to-reservation dominance, and exact successful phase sequence and unit closure for validity; normalize diagnostics to the top level, sanitize reflected digests, bound diagnostics to 256 items, 65536 bytes total, and 2048 bytes per item, and cap the complete serialized report at 8 MiB
inputs.verifier_output_contract: apply one finite grammar to the Python-decoded output string before Path construction or normalization: verifier and producer CLI parsers retain --output as an exact decoded str; verifier main preflights that raw string before input verification and passes the same string to the writer; accept exact str, pathlib.Path, and os.PathLike yielding exact str; reject bytes and byte-valued path-like objects, string subclasses, unsupported or null objects, empty strings, embedded NUL, relative strings, terminal slash, terminal dot components, explicit parent traversal, and the exact POSIX double-separator anchor; normalize internal dot and repeated separators and, on the controlled POSIX runtime, any three-or-more leading separator run to the ordinary root anchor, then admit only a nonroot destination below the development root; arbitrary caller __fspath__ code executes before its return value can be classified, so caller-created effects are outside the no-destination guarantee, which begins after os.fspath returns and covers verifier-created effects for inert inputs; the descriptor walker invokes the same grammar and independently enforces normalized root containment before opening root-relative parents no-follow; preflight both deterministic no-overwrite names; publish data and a separate canonical completion receipt by descriptor-relative RENAME_EXCL or same-directory hard link where supported, with a descriptor-relative O_EXCL direct-write path exercised by forced ENOTSUP controls; bind the receipt to a random 256-bit publication identifier, destination basename, development-root-relative destination path, payload bytes and SHA-256, experiment, protocol, and canonical self-digest; on an ordinary synchronous exception after receipt publication begins, return accepted with a structured warning only if terminal validation matches that exact identifier and payload; fail closed on observed direct-write inode type or size mismatch; classify absent, orphaned, malformed, payload-mismatch, and attempt-mismatch states as unaccepted; preserve warnings and external durability evidence in any future runner; make no claim about raw argv bytes before Python decoding, shell or OS decoding, authentication, BaseException, memory exhaustion, process death, real-filesystem support, or durability

optimizer.constrained_caps: deduplicated sorted values floor(q/4), floor(q/2), floor(3q/4), q
optimizer.bound_method: conflict-clique-cover cardinality plus global pair-output union
optimizer.canonical_exactness: every cap must terminate full_objective_proved with exact Boolean primary/full flags, equal integer lower/upper bounds, integer absolute_gap=0, integer remaining_frontier_nodes=0, an empty frontier whose digest is SHA-256 of [], and an independent depth-first primary proof; outside frozen B4 the secondary constrained-count, edge-count, retained-maxima, and lexical fields are replay-confirmed by the deterministic verifier rather than a structurally separate complete oracle
optimizer.unresolved_policy: one unresolved primary or secondary cell invalidates the entire matrix and yields INCONCLUSIVE

family_gate.full_cap_persistence: for one fixed coordinate family, the exact median retained_to_balanced_raw ratio across two seeds and three B values is at least 1/4 in every bit stratum
family_gate.fixed_pair_rule: one same coordinate family and one same cap fraction must pass across strata
family_gate.null_median: exact arithmetic mean of the middle two of four precommitted null supports
family_gate.null_duplicate_policy: retain duplicate null selections and duplicate support values without resampling or deduplication
family_gate.stratum_rule: median of the six coordinate-minus-null-median-minus-threshold values is nonnegative
family_gate.family_cap_rule: at least three of four strata pass and at least 18 of 24 coordinate-minus-null-median comparisons are positive
family_gate.multiple_candidates: the preregistered gate evaluates six family-cap pairs and reports every passing pair
family_gate.negative_classification: COLLAPSE iff every coordinate family has full-cap median retention below 1/10 in at least three bit strata; otherwise a complete all-pair FAIL is WEAKEN_OR_REJECT

source_interface.rule: every constrained coordinate label has exactly one emitted public formal source in a label-to-formal table
source_interface.charge: the complete source table is public advice included in public-model and per-cap serialized-byte receipts
source_interface.final_edge: the public partial operation contains no retained-4F by retained-4F edge; final support is private audit data

accounting.structural_work: independently reconstructible combinatorial cell counts only; not CPU instructions or complete field-operation counts
accounting.cap_locality: each cap has an independent model cache and reconstructed optimizer/search receipts
accounting.serialized_bytes: canonical-JSON sizes of the public model, private audit, row payload, and nested per-cap objects; these measures are explicitly nonadditive
accounting.wall_time: producer-observed nonnegative row and cap durations only; not independently reconstructed
accounting.memory: no producer peak-memory claim; future canonical roles require external runner peak RSS and memory-bandwidth accounting
accounting.verifier: V18 path receipts expose invocation-local source-bounded reservations, exact completed-path registered cache lookup/miss, provenance/predicate, and frozen/semantic/primary point-enumeration counts, exact completed-row graph candidate, eligible-conflict, eligible-pair-output, and expansion counter deltas, observed replay/proof/cache/retained-model work, partial failing-function lower bounds, explicit actual-work completeness, unit-counted aggregate phases, phase-closure validity, and validity-enforced actual-to-reservation dominance; state is thread-owned, explicitly closed, and path-worker re-entry guarded; the input path uses one exact-size snapshot buffer, lexical preflight, and buffer clearing before object construction; output acceptance requires a path-bound, attempt-bound completion receipt and exact terminal reconciliation, while forced unsupported-publication fallbacks, terminal orphan/invalid/attempt-mismatch states, and post-commit warnings are separately classified; the module-load source digest remains diagnostic and future CPU, wall time, allocator retention, parser-object bytes, peak RSS, memory traffic, disk, and I/O remain separate role costs that may not be omitted from an end-to-end claim

development_only_budget.allowed: unit, abstract-graph, generated-curve-provenance, generated factor-base, one frozen p=19 B4 density row/document control, and exactly three transient noncanonical frozen legacy semantic rows at B=4,6,8; zero generated V18 curve-family density rows and zero canonical runs; preserve the 17 historical V1 development rows and one historical development run manifest as non-V18 evidence

inputs.canonical_launch_gate: fresh independent theory, accounting, and red-team GO on a committed V18 snapshot, followed by a separately reviewed hash-complete execution plan and coordinator approval

controls: Reproduce the frozen p=19,a=2,b=9,q=23 predecessor outcomes without changing its predicate or representative compiler.
Re-run inherited hash-bound abstract and EC controls without weakening their predicate vectors.
Exact-compare graph independence with direct full-closure injectivity on every subset of the frozen B=4 fixture.
Exact-compare branch-and-bound and density objectives with exhaustive small-graph optima, including objective ties.
Force a zero-node optimizer cap and require a nonzero certified interval containing the exact optimum.
Reconstruct the complete frontier certificate and deterministic optimizer replay independently.
Require a separate depth-first primary proof to finish for every canonical cap cell.
Independently recount degree 1, 2, 4, and 8 support and both formal-multiset and ordered-tuple energy measures.
Independently derive every curve draw, duplicate record, complete rejection-reason list, accepted curve, and cross-seed uniqueness result.
Independently derive every factor-base predicate, Mobius nonce, pole list, hash-null ranking, root polynomial, and sign pair.
Reject illegal coordinate/null replicate bindings and every appended scalar-material key.
Reject mutations to objective order, ordering contract, representative table, public source table, optimizer exactness, structural work, and byte receipts after refreshing outer digests.

Reject exact-type aliases including integer zero to Boolean false, integer zero to negative float zero, integer to equal float, Boolean to integer, and malformed ratios, masks, counts, node caps, wall times, and byte receipts.
Reject extra keys in nested rejection and conflict transcripts.
Reject empty, incomplete, extra, duplicate, reordered, wrong-cap, wrong-node-cap, inconsistent-curve, and cross-seed-duplicate canonical matrices.
Exact-match producer and independently implemented family-gate outputs on a complete synthetic 168-row matrix.
Require both gate implementations to reject each independent mutation of bounds, gap, exactness flags, remaining frontier, frontier contents and digest, or termination, plus any missing row.
Use the verifier-assisted exhaustive oracle to compare every field of the full density objective on all independent subsets of the frozen B=4 fixture.

Use a standalone frozen-B4 oracle that independently rebuilds EC addition, factor-base fibers, representative compilation, ideals, graph conflicts, retained-model costs, final support, and every five-field cap winner without producer or verifier semantic helpers.

Return deterministic invalid receipts for truncated cap schedules, invalid and duplicate selected formals, negative caps, malformed JSON, nonobject roots, duplicate keys, and invalid verifier budgets.
Reject every V1-V17 schema without row verification and never advertise V18 mathematical checks on a legacy receipt.

Hash and parse one immutable regular-file byte snapshot; reject directories, final-component symlinks, FIFOs, and initially oversized sparse files before reading or JSON parsing; permit and disclose parent-component symlink traversal; prove that a later path change cannot alter the verified bytes or receipt hash.

Reject huge curve bits, nonregistered curve transcripts, wrong source-owned node caps, invalid document row amplification, and aggregate replay reservations before curve, row, replay, or proof semantics.

Emit an ordered phase ledger from actual control flow; require aggregate row/cap phases to report expected, completed, and failed units, and list a phase as an independent check only after every registered unit passes.

Use a standalone frozen-B4 oracle that derives p=19, a=2, b=9, q=23, B=4, caps, factor-base record, representative compiler, every candidate formal with every recursive parent pair, the complete eligible list, full rejection/conflict graph transcripts, and every cap transcript without following emitted curve, B, or caps.

Use hand-derived exact family-gate fixtures for the discriminating duplicate-null multiset [8,8,10,12], exact 1/4 persistence versus one rational step below, strict 1/10 collapse boundary, 17/18 versus 18/24 positives, two/three passing strata, fixed-cap anti-splicing, every-family collapse, and noncollapse.

Patch both frozen and registered curve derivation helpers and prove that bad row digests, nonempty frontiers, wrong objectives, oversized masks, and oversized B-derived transcripts trigger zero curve, replay, and proof work.

Inject replay and primary-proof failures on the second cap and after nonzero work inside the failing function; require preservation of the reservation, all observed prior and failing-cap nodes/caches, failed unit count, normalized top-level diagnostic, and actual_work_complete=false.

Amplify malformed diagnostics and reflected digest values; require source ceilings on count, total bytes, item bytes, and the complete serialized report including its size receipt and verification hash.
Verify that the verifier source digest is a frozen module-load diagnostic, is never recomputed for a report, and explicitly carries no executed-code attestation claim.

Disable both public direct verification APIs before any curve, graph, replay, or proof helper; reject public generated-curve and legacy-row construction and every non-frozen public density-row association before factor-base work; require path-based verify_document for evidence.

Reject one-over and wrong-type map, alternating-position, rejection-reason, polynomial, formal, edge, source-table, frontier, byte-receipt, parameter, summary, and nested family-gate collections before generic JSON traversal or mathematical helpers.
Authenticate nested curve, factor-base, representative, edge, source-table, frontier, and byte-accounting receipts and reconstruct summary/family gate before resource reservation or curve semantics.

Assert the exact frozen successful actual-work vector, including one frozen enumeration, one semantic enumeration, four primary enumerations, 218 replay nodes, 250 primary nodes, all cache entries, retained-model calls/cells, and its exact source-owned reservation mapping.
Force an otherwise valid path receipt to exceed one reservation field and require a failed actual_work_reservation_dominance phase and invalid report.

Inject a failure after the second graph-candidate, eligible-conflict, expansion, and eligible-pair-output charge; require the exact partial count, failed graph/expansion unit, and actual_work_complete=false.

Suppress each graph-candidate, eligible-conflict, eligible-pair-output, and expansion charge on an otherwise completed row, then overcharge one candidate evaluation; require exact reconstructed-delta mismatch invalidation while actual_work_complete remains true.
Suppress one otherwise successful primary-proof phase update and require final phase-closure invalidation.
Pass an over-report-ceiling caller path with an invalid budget and require a bounded invalid receipt rather than an exception.

Construct exactly three transient noncanonical frozen legacy semantic controls at B=4,6,8, record their row digests, reproduce the predecessor values, and classify all three separately from the sole B4 density-row/document control and from generated curve-family rows.

Call every internal legacy-row, density-row, document-value, test-wrapper, registered-curve, path-worker, and path-worker-body semantic entry point without its active permit/token and require rejection before mathematical work.
Pass Boolean, zero, negative, float, string, and null work-charge amounts and require exact-type rejection with no counter mutation.

Overlap two complete frozen path verifications at the first graph-candidate charge and nest one complete verification inside another factor-base reconstruction; require each complete receipt to equal the serial baseline and require restoration to no active state after return.

Inject an escaping public-worker exception and require the inner state to close and the exact outer context to return; during an authenticated callback reject direct path-worker re-entry, copied-context cross-thread semantic use, and later same-thread use of the closed copied state.

Publish one descriptor-bound no-overwrite data/receipt pair and validate its canonical receipt, relative destination, random publication identifier, and exact payload binding with a standalone parser that shares no production status implementation; preserve the pair on retry, preserve a race-created data destination without a receipt, reject a parent symlink, and reject a later payload mismatch.

Force unsupported-publication direct writes and interrupt first the data write and then the completion-receipt write; classify them as an unaccepted orphan and unaccepted invalid receipt, and prove the terminal paths cannot be overwritten.

After complete destination publication inject directory-fsync failure and actual hard-link-success temporary-cleanup failure; require an accepted return with structured warnings and a matching completion receipt rather than a contradictory exception.
Leave a stale receipt after removing its data and retry the identical payload; require preflight failure before any replacement data is created.

Race two distinct publication identifiers at one destination; require one accepted exact attempt, one no-overwrite failure, and public plus standalone status attribution only to the winning identifier.

Inject an ordinary synchronous exception immediately after receipt commit through rename, actual hard link, and forced direct O_EXCL publication; require exact-attempt reconciliation, an accepted return, and a structured warning.
Force a short direct receipt write that returns without a write error; require observed size mismatch to fail and both production and standalone status to remain unaccepted.

Apply the finite output-path grammar across verifier and producer CLI parsing, verifier preflight ordering, the public writer, receipt-path, status, standalone status, and private descriptor walker: preserve terminal slash and terminal dot strings through CLI parsing; admit exact absolute strings, pathlib.Path, custom exact-string os.PathLike, internal dot and repeated-separator aliases, and three, four, and seven leading separators; reject exact leading double separators, explicit parent traversal, relative in-root and escaping strings, terminal slash and terminal dot components, the development root, ordinary outside paths, empty and NUL-bearing strings, direct bytes, byte-valued path-like objects, string subclasses, and null objects before normalization; require inert rejected classes to create no verifier destination and verifier main to reject invalid output before input verification or writing; demonstrate separately that arbitrary __fspath__ callbacks may create caller effects before return-value validation; publish through the combined raw alias and require post-publication production and standalone attribution through every admitted spelling. Separately require production writer/status and descriptor traversal to reject a symlinked parent while preserving the standalone parser's disclosed non-race boundary.

Recompute the non-self-referential V18 review-surface inventory from exact paths, exact flat-directory selectors, static experiment rules, and four exact historical-development paths; reject control-bearing or non-ASCII selected paths, require every selected entry to be a regular nonexecutable 100644 blob, encode sorted mode, type, and raw path records with NUL delimiters, and require the exact entry count and SHA-256, no predicted commit or tree identifier, exact-commit and exact-tree reviewer checks, zero generated V18 curve-family density rows, zero canonical runs, and explicit preservation of 17 historical V1 development rows plus one historical development run manifest.

Re-sign a receipt with a different valid publication identifier and require ordinary unkeyed status to accept it while exact-attempt reconciliation rejects it; re-sign a wrong relative path and Boolean payload byte count and require both validators to reject them.
Verify a complete frozen-fixture V18 document under the closed exact-type document, row, summary, gate, accounting, and report schemas.
Keep every V18 family-row and canonical run budget at zero until fresh review.

stopping_rules: Do not create a V18 curve-family row or canonical run while status is review_required or maximum_runs is zero.
Stop before launch if any inherited, provenance, closed-schema, exactness, gate, source-table, or accounting control fails.

If any canonical cap reaches its node or role wall budget without an independent primary proof and deterministic complete secondary replay, invalidate the whole matrix and report INCONCLUSIVE; frozen B4 additionally requires standalone complete five-field agreement.
Do not substitute another curve, seed, B, predicate, null replicate, representative compiler, cap, objective, median, threshold, or optimizer budget after approval.
Do not sum nested byte receipts or label structural cell counts as field operations, instructions, peak memory, or end-to-end attack cost.
invalidation_rules: The producer, result, or verifier-visible payload contains scalar indices, a discrete-log table, scalar-derived factor-base selection, or another forbidden scalar-material key.

Any V18 row, document, summary, family-gate, nested integrity, accounting, report, publication receipt, or publication result field has the wrong exact JSON type, an open key set, an out-of-range structural value, or an ordering-contract mismatch.

The verifier input is changing or nonregular, exceeds a V18 byte, lexical-token, scalar-token, reflected-path, source-collection, node, depth, string, diagnostic, complete-report, B-derived transcript, registered-grid, replay, cache, retained-model, point-enumeration, hash, or primary-proof ceiling, uses insignificant external JSON whitespace, uses a direct non-evidence API, or uses any V1-V17 or unknown schema.

A verifier output lacks a complete canonical V18 completion receipt, the receipt has an open key set or wrong exact type, or its publication identifier, destination basename, root-relative path, byte-count, payload-hash, protocol, experiment, canonical encoding, or self-digest binding fails.

The canonical document is not the exact ordered 168-row grid, not all 672 primary optima are independently proved, or any five-field objective fails deterministic replay; only frozen B4 carries a structurally separate complete five-field oracle.
Curve, factor-base, Mobius, null, representative, graph, source-table, or transcript provenance differs under independent reconstruction.
A candidate and null are compared at different curves, B values, absolute constrained-label caps, or optimizer budgets.
Any coordinate or hash-null replicate falls outside its frozen role and range.
Graph feasibility disagrees with direct closure injectivity on any exhaustive audit row.
An optimizer objective, bound, replay, or independent proof disagrees with the serialized result.
Formal-multiset energy is substituted for ordered-tuple additive energy or either denominator is omitted.
Private search state, source advice, representative advice, final-pair witnesses, verifier work, or external resources are treated as free.
Any direct retained-4F by retained-4F public edge is present.
A toy model effect is interpreted as an exponent, relation generator, target descent, preprocessing crossover, rho improvement, or ECDLP result.
experiment.success_criterion: After separate launch approval and two valid canonical roles, record a scoped positive toy signal only if the exact ordered 168-row and 672-cap-cell matrix passes every check, every primary optimum is independently proved, every complete five-field objective is replay-confirmed, and at least one same fixed coordinate-family and cap-fraction pair passes the preregistered V18 gate: full-cap exact median retained/balanced-raw support at least 1/4 in every bit stratum, matched-cap median threshold margin nonnegative in at least three strata, and positive coordinate-minus-four-null-median support in at least 18 of 24 curve-B comparisons.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Given one complete valid exact canonical matrix, return a scoped WEAKEN or REJECT if no fixed coordinate-family and cap-fraction pair passes both persistence and matched-null rules. Record COLLAPSE only if every family has exact median retained/balanced-raw support below 1/10 at full cap in at least three strata. Any missing row, unresolved cap, invalid control, provenance mismatch, resource exhaustion, or verifier failure is INCONCLUSIVE rather than evidence against the mathematical hypothesis.
required_artifacts: future hash-complete execution plan and coordinator approval
